about_the_game:
◼︎Oiran Survival is a high-density survival action game set in a dark Japanese fantasy world, where you fight as the courtesan Kochou and carve through hordes of yokai.

The more intense the battle becomes, the more your carefully chosen skills and equipment begin to matter.

Slash through enemies with your war fan, unleash devastating Limit Break skills, and turn the tide with deadly dance techniques.
Experience a battle system that blends Japanese elegance with explosive screen-clearing action.

◼︎ Skills evolve beyond their limits

During battle, you defeat enemies, collect EXP, and choose from 13 different skills to strengthen your build.

Each skill grows through multiple stages, and once certain conditions are met, it can awaken into a Limit Break (MAX) form.
These are not just stronger versions of normal skills, but entirely new phenomena unleashed on the battlefield.

Wipe out massive waves of yokai in a single activation and experience the core thrill of Oiran Survival: overwhelming destruction and pure combat satisfaction.

◼︎ Equipment and 9 elements change how Kochou fights


Kochou can be strengthened not only through weapons, but also through equipment such as kimono, obi, hairstyles, and hair accessories.

There are over 600 pieces of equipment to collect and combine.
Fan weapons come in multiple elemental types, including standard, ice, fire, wind, and water, along with even more powerful Extreme variants.
Your loadout can significantly change your attack power, HP, defense, special effects, elemental damage, and elemental resistance.

The yokai you face also carry 9 different elemental attributes, so choosing the right offensive build and defensive resistance becomes a key part of survival.

Build your own version of Kochou, adapt to every enemy type, and enjoy a deep progression system with wide customization and replay value.

Adjust your equipment, elements, and resistances to counter the 9 types of yokai.

◼︎ Turn the battle around with deadly dances and Limit Breaks

The moment you are surrounded, Kochou’s deadly dance can completely reverse the flow of battle.

Massive screen-clearing attacks, devastating Limit Break skills, and fierce yet beautiful presentation come together in the signature combat style of Oiran Survival.

Experience the thrill of wiping out overwhelming enemy waves in an instant, where elegance and brutality collide.

◼︎ Conversations and changing expressions deepen the story

Between battles, quiet moments await as you spend time with Kochou in the pleasure district.

As you talk with her, offer certain items, and deepen your bond, her attitude, expressions, and the sides of herself she reveals will gradually begin to change.

This is more than just surviving waves of enemies.
The closer you grow to Kochou, the deeper your connection to the world becomes.

Intense combat and delicate emotional expression exist side by side, creating another defining layer of Oiran Survival.

Key Features

  • High-density survival action where you fight as Kochou and cut through hordes of yokai

  • Choose from 13 skills, strengthen them, and evolve them into powerful Limit Break (MAX) forms

  • Satisfying screen-clearing attacks, deadly dances, and large-scale crowd destruction

  • Deep build customization with over 600 pieces of equipment

  • Strengthen Kochou with weapons, kimono, obi, hairstyles, hair accessories, and more

  • Adapt your build to counter 9 elemental yokai types with offense, defense, and resistances

  • Seductive Live2D character presentation and expressive animation

  • A relationship system where Kochou’s attitude changes through conversation and gifts

  • Roguelite-style progression with stage-based level resets

  • Dense, fast-paced runs built around roughly 13-minute stages

World

Behind the beauty of the pleasure district lies a world of yokai and blood rituals.
A dark fantasy setting where Japanese elegance and decay intertwine.

Every time the courtesan dances, blood stains the night.

Supported Languages

  • Japanese

  • English

  • Simplified Chinese

  • Traditional Chinese

Controls

  • Keyboard & Mouse

Voice Cast

  • Narration: Kouko Tsukimoto

  • Kochou (Character Voice): Akiko Tani

Voice Production / Casting Support

  • Artist Crew Co., Ltd.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent combat scenes and mild blood effects when defeating enemies. No sexual content or nudity is present.
